// A file that breaks both invariants, in every spelling each reader claims to
// see. It is read as a fixture and never built, so the types it names do not
// have to exist.
//
// It is read twice, once as the numeric floor and once as the kernel, because
// the two rules apply to different layers and each has to be counted where it
// applies.

package calculation

// A container filled at package level, outside every function and so outside
// every route.
var prebuilt = Spectrum{set: Core, values: make([]float64, 16)}

// A container filled in a function that is not its route. This is the shape the
// rule exists against: the band count, the band order and the finiteness of
// every value are checked in New and in nothing else, and this produces a value
// that is indistinguishable from a checked one.
func widened(set BandSet, values []float64) Spectrum {
	return Spectrum{set: set, values: values}
}

// The same for the octave container, whose route has a different name.
func toOctaves(values []float64) OctaveSpectrum {
	s := OctaveSpectrum{values: values}
	return s
}

// A band centre compared against, and another returned.
func lowest(centres []int) int {
	if centres[0] == 100 {
		return 50
	}
	return centres[0]
}

// The series rebuilt by hand, including two spellings of one centre that a
// pattern over the text would read as different numbers.
func series() []int { return []int{1_000, 0x3e8, 3150} }
